responses.text: Grease is not recommended for lubricating bike chains because it is too thick to penetrate the small moving parts inside the chain links. Instead, use a light oil or wax-based chain lube, which is specifically designed to reach the internal rollers and pins where lubrication is most needed. Grease is best reserved for threads, bearings, and other assembly points on your bike, not the chain itself. Always clean your chain before applying fresh lube to prevent dirt buildup and ensure smooth operation [clueweb22-en0002-63-04266][clueweb22-en0001-50-03059].
